properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): proof designs get software-shaped gaps and readings because the reasoning-membership test stopped counting assumed premises (a 10-17 regression), a hypothesis has no truth branch, and encoding_undecided is not gated, so the capability "the gaps fit a proof" fails whenever a design's domain hint does not say proof
properties.statement:
MEASURED 2026-10-22 on the heat-equation rung (7f5bd325ad4e8c91), reflow2 0.90.0, code at origin/main e6d4b5a4f (the same lines as v0.90.0). It recurred the same day on the Lucas–Penrose trial (cd9bedc1cb114de6). The root-cause skill was followed: candidates were refuted by measurement, and the observer spot-checked inference.rs.

THREE CODE CAUSES, ONE CLASS: proof statements fall through to predicates written for software requirements.

1. REGRESSION: `takes_part_in_reasoning` (inference.rs ~5069) uses `steps_resting_on` (~1602), which filters out `role == "assumed"` (~1606).
   - 8dd1a7bab (phase 1, 10-16) built the membership test on that helper.
   - 4879171c5 (phase 2, 10-17) narrowed the helper to what a CHANGE reaches, for the what-if, and so narrowed "takes part in reasoning" too.
   - Effects: unlinked_intent reports hypotheses that are only ever assumed (relate.rs:609). And `is_a_reasoning_design` (detect.rs:2044) is false unless every live requirement takes part, so concept_without_design (:3181), quality_target_unstated (:4070), artifact_standard_undeclared (:7877) and closure_criterion_undeclared (:8342) come back.
   - Comparison designs: logic, π+e and Arrow are rescued by a domain naming "proof", cogito by "argument". Brocard ("mathematics: an open Diophantine problem") shows all four gaps, exactly as heat ("document", set by the observer's genesis call) does.
2. `own_truth` (inference.rs ~2765) has no branch for statement_kind hypothesis, so a discharged hypothesis reads "unknown: not delivered", while `statement_reading` (~3573) reads it "discharged". The two readers disagree. On Lucas–Penrose the same fall-through reads every objection and reply "not delivered".
3. `detect_encoding_undecided` (detect.rs:8401) is not gated for statements that carry statement_kind. It asks for a software `kind` on all six proof designs and on 40 argument statements, while design-a-proof says to leave `kind` alone.

GOVERNANCE CONTRADICTION: the genesis skill says `domain` is "never a switch on what reflow2 computes", yet detect.rs switches on it (names_a_line_of_reasoning, :1984). design-a-proof never tells an agent to set it.

RECURRENCE: encoding_undecided is rung-2 friction item 5 (fact:the-proof-trial-rung-2-ran-on-flo2-io-and-what-counts-holds-while-recording-a-proof-is-still-costly-2026-10-17). The Brocard design showed the gap set earlier with no recorded cause.

FIX (in the reflow2 PR after phase 7 PR 4):
- takes_part_in_reasoning counts assumed premises; steps_resting_on stays as it is for propagation;
- own_truth gets a hypothesis branch consistent with statement_reading;
- encoding_undecided is gated on statement_kind;
- the structural test suffices, and the domain hint remains only as a fallback.

The RCA data files are in scratchpad heat-trial/rca/. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
